name: Taj Mahal
description: The Taj Mahal is a gleaming ivory-white marble mausoleum beside the Yamuna River in Agra, India. Emperor Shah Jahan commissioned it in 1631 for his late wife, Mumtaz Mahal, and the tomb was finished in 1648 by more than 20,000 workers and artisans. Semi-precious stones are inlaid in its marble, and formal gardens, a mosque and red sandstone buildings surround it.
